description: iTunes AAC encoder (Apple's CoreAudioToolbox 7.10.9.0) iTunes 12.13.12.3, converted through iTunes' ConvertFile2: AAC Encoder, preset Spoken Podcasts, on the synthetic source music-44k-stereo.wav.

encoder.note: At low bitrates iTunes picks the output rate itself.

input.name: music-44k-stereo.wav
input.generator: sources/make_sources.py of the sample kit (written from nothing, reproducible byte for byte)

note: The encoder stamps the time of the encode into the file; the file is committed as written, and checked by its content.
